message.content:
## Recent developments
* **Financial Performance & Scale:** Perplexity AI’s answer engine surpassed a US$750 million annual run-rate, tripling its revenue over the past year by transitioning into an enterprise-focused AI agent platform named "Computer." Major enterprise deployments include companies like PayPal handling tens of thousands of weekly queries.
* **Product & Feature Launches:** 
  * Perplexity released **"Teammates,"** an agentic AI feature allowing multiple autonomous agents to collaborate on tasks like QA, customer service, and research. Initially limited to iOS and the web, Teammates rolled out to the Mac app for Max subscribers in mid-November 2026.
  * The company released open-weight **Decider v1.3** and **Flash** models under an Apache 2.0 license on Hugging Face on November 13, 2026, targeting specialized decision-making and text-classification workloads.
* **Legal Challenges:** Perplexity faced a new class action lawsuit filed in California federal court by consumer Ntsikelelo Bonga over allegedly undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features.

## Talking points
* **Enterprise Expansion:** Discuss how Perplexity is scaling its enterprise solutions (such as "Computer" and "Teammates") to convert heavy user traffic into sustainable B2B revenue streams.
* **Open-Source and Model Strategy:** Inquire about the strategic intent behind releasing the Decider v1.3 open weights and how it integrates into their broader multi-model orchestration framework.
* **Ecosystem Integration:** Touch upon hardware and OS integrations, such as its system-level placement on Samsung's Galaxy S26 via Galaxy AI.

## Open questions
* How is Perplexity addressing customer friction and legal risk regarding the recent class action lawsuit over subscription usage limits?
* What are the primary infrastructure and compute hurdles as enterprise agent use (like Teammates) scales rapidly across cloud providers like AWS and Microsoft Azure?
* What is the current roadmap for monetization of the newly released open-weight Decider models?

## Sources
* [Perplexity Decider v1.3 & Flash Open Weights — CASRAI](https://casrai.org/news/perplexity-pplx-decider-v1-3-open-weights-release-2026)
* [Perplexity: AI Answer Engine Tops US$750m Run-Rate | AI Magazine](https://aimagazine.com/news/perplexity-ai-answer-engine-tops-us-750m-run-rate)
* [Perplexity AI sued over undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features](https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/lawsuit-news/perplexity-ai-sued-over-undisclosed-usage-caps-on-paid-subscription-features)
* [Perplexity brings AI agents feature called Teammates to the Mac - 9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/13/perplexity-brings-ai-agents-feature-called-teammates-to-the-mac)
